map.name: Orb of the Illusioner Level 2
map.testedVersion: Static source audit only; runtime not executed

bugs.title: Weapon and armor upgrades consume coins then fail
bugs.problem: Normal weapon or armor upgrades deduct coins and then fail before delivering the upgrade, leaving players with lost currency.
bugs.expected: A valid upgrade delivers the requested item tier, and any failed delivery leaves the player's coin balance unchanged.
bugs.observed: Coins are consumed before code references an undefined material identifier, causing the upgrade to fail without refund.
reproduction: Enter an Orb L2 session and obtain enough coins for a valid weapon or armor upgrade.
Open the normal upgrade UI and buy the next available tier.
Check whether the upgrade fails while the spent coins remain deducted.
bugs.aiAnalysis: UpgradeManager validates the tier and coin cost, consumes coins, then passes an undeclared material identifier into weapon or armor replacement. The resulting ReferenceError is caught as an upgrade failure, but the already consumed currency is not refunded.

relevantCode.file: UpgradeManager in the selected artifact scripts
relevantCode.reason: Owns weapon/armor upgrade validation, coin consumption, item replacement, and tier persistence.

bugs.suggestedFix: Derive and validate the target material before charging coins, then make delivery atomic or refund currency on any post-charge failure.
mustPreserve: Existing tier progression and affordability rules must remain unchanged.

bugs.title: Active-game reload recovery aborts the arena
bugs.problem: Reloading an active Orb L2 game triggers a recovery error that resets the arena and returns players to the lobby instead of resuming the session.
bugs.expected: A persisted active game resumes and reconciles its stage barricades without terminating the arena.
bugs.observed: Scheduled reload validation references undefined selectedBarricades, throws, and sends the active arena into internal-error recovery.
reproduction: Start Orb of the Illusioner Level 2 and reach active Offense gameplay.
Restart the world while the active match is still in progress.
Rejoin after the world finishes loading and wait a few seconds for recovery.
Check whether the arena resets and players return to the lobby instead of the match resuming.
bugs.aiAnalysis: The reload path schedules validateBarricadeStates after restoration. That method references selectedBarricades even though the identifier exists only as a parameter elsewhere. The resulting ReferenceError is classified as an arena recovery failure, causing disposal/reset.

relevantCode.file: Offense game manager in the selected artifact scripts
relevantCode.reason: Owns active-game resume, barricade validation, scheduler error handling, and arena recovery.

bugs.suggestedFix: Make reload validation iterate the stage's configured barricades or pass the intended set explicitly through the existing recovery owner.
mustPreserve: Existing persisted-session resume timing and arena cleanup ownership must remain intact.
